description: The elements a behavior contract `relations` entry may name that are not anatomy parts of the component (spec/behavior-contract.md#relations). The vocabulary is closed: add a role only with an owner decision. SPEC-126 reads this list.

values.label: Trigger
values.description: The element that shows, opens or controls the component and is supplied by the host (the control a tooltip describes). It is not part of the component's anatomy.

values.label: Owner
values.description: The element that contains or owns the component in the host's tree (the field a help text belongs to).

values.label: Label
values.description: An element outside the component's anatomy that names it.

values.label: Description
values.description: An element outside the component's anatomy that describes it.
